  Profile Summary
 
 
 16+ years of experience in Banking and Financial Services with strong expertise in Payments, Cards, 
SWIFT, ISO 20022, ISO 8583, NEFT, RTGS, Reconciliation, and payment message processing. 
 
 Extensive experience in product ownership, business analysis, stakeholder management,  
requirement gathering, governance, implementation, and change management  across payment 
systems. 
 
  Strong understanding of ISO 20022  payment messaging standards and migration from legacy 
MT/IFTAS/SFMS messaging formats to MX/ISO 20022 standards across payment, trade finance, and 
cash management systems 
 
 Hands-on experience in NEFT, RTGS, SWIFT MT103, MT202, MT199, MT191, MT192, and ISO 
20022 messages such as pacs.008, pacs.009, pacs.002, camt.056, camt.029, and pain.001. 
 
 Strong hands -on expertise in card issuing, authorization, clearing, settlement, reconciliation, 
disputes, and scheme compliance (Visa & Mastercard) . Proven ability to manage end -to-end 
delivery, covering requirements gathering, backlog management, stakeholder coordination, 
governance, and execution in Agile environments. 
 
 Strong exposure to application interface design, API integration, requirement documentation , 
interface mapping, deployment, implementation, and production support. 
 
 Proven ability to work with cross-functional teams, member banks, business stakeholders, product 
teams, development teams, and vendors to ensure successful implementation of payment system 
changes. 
 
 Experienced in preparing BRD, FRD, User Stories, Functional Specifications, Process Flows , Gap 
Analysis, Impact Analysis, and Change Requests. 
 
 Strong people management and leadership skills with experience mentoring teams, managing 
multiple activities in parallel, and delivering projects in fast-paced, 24x7 environments. 
 
 Strong understanding of the end -to-end flow of RTGS and NEFT transactions including:  Customer 
Initiation, Branch Validation, Core Banking System Processing, SFMS/RTGS message generation, 
RBI Settlement, Beneficiary Bank Acknowledgement, Final Credit Confirmation. 
 
 Familiar with payment responses such as:  Positive Acknowledgement, Rejection Response, 
Return/Reject Scenarios, pac.002 status messages, UTR generation and tracking. 
 
 Strong knowledge of payment message statuses such as Accepted, Rejected, Pending, Returned, 
Settled, and Failed.
